versos.texto_bv: O Senhor se tornou como inimigo; devorou Israel, devorou todos os seus palácios, destruiu as suas fortalezas; multiplicou, na filha de Judá, pranto sobre pranto.
versos.traducao_literal: Tornou-se o-Senhor como-inimigo; devorou Israel, devorou todos-os-seus-palácios, destruiu suas-fortalezas; e-multiplicou na-filha-de-Judá pranto e-lamento.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): "pranto sobre pranto" (repetição intensificadora do mesmo substantivo) diverge da traducao_literal, que registra dois substantivos hebraicos distintos ("pranto e-lamento"), e das referências ARA/NVIPT, que preservam o dueto enumerativo ("pranto e a lamentação" / "prantos e lamentações"). — evidência: traducao_literal: "...e-multiplicou na-filha-de-Judá pranto e-lamento."; ARA: "multiplicou na filha de Judá o pranto e a lamentação"; NVIPT: "Tem feito multiplicar os prantos e as lamentações da filha de Judá."; BV atual: "pranto sobre pranto".

kjv.texto: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

vizinhos.4: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
vizinhos.6: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the Lord hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

web.texto: The Lord has become as an enemy, he has swallowed up Israel; He has swallowed up all her palaces, he has destroyed his strongholds; He has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

vizinhos.4: He has bent his bow like an enemy, he has stood with his right hand as an adversary, Has killed all that were pleasant to the eye: In the tent of the daughter of Zion he has poured out his wrath like fire.
vizinhos.6: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden; he has destroyed his place of assembly: Yahweh has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, Has despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
